title: quick-fix ukrainian bok choi stir-fry
description: a simple, buttery, and glassy-jelly ukrainian dish featuring bok choi, perfect for a quick weeknight meal
instructions: heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add the bok choy and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 3 minutes.
add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
add the chicken broth and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes, until the liquid has almost completely evaporated.
stir in the coconut cream and cook for 1 minute, until the mixture is smooth and heated through.
remove from heat and stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter, salt, and black pepper.
sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
